gallery.title: Gamification Labs | Holistic Tech Solutions Group
gallery.description: Play Agency Invaders, Launch Runner, Trivia Challenge and Crossword Break. Four free browser games with touch and keyboard controls.

play.title: Play arcade games | HTSG Gamification Labs
play.description: Take a playful agency flight, double-jump with Halo or test your digital know-how. Choose a game, or take a Crossword Break from the game menu.

invaders.title: Agency Invaders | HTSG Gamification Labs
invaders.description: Pick your ship and paint, power up with Wingmates or Relay Pulse, and enjoy the funny side of agency life. Free play with touch or keyboard controls.

runner.title: Launch Runner | HTSG Gamification Labs
runner.description: Double-jump with Halo across a futuristic launch complex. Clear barriers, collect energy, and keep moving in Launch Runner.

trivia.title: Trivia Challenge | HTSG Gamification Labs
trivia.description: Explore three five-question rounds about strategy, design, and trust. Choose an answer, learn why it works, and build a streak.

crossword.title: Crossword Break | HTSG Gamification Labs
crossword.description: Take a Crossword Break with three original mini puzzles, touch and keyboard controls, clue checks and letter hints. Your progress stays on this device.
